entities.summary: The Jāmeh Mosque of Ashtarjan, also known as the Jameh Mosque of Imanshahr and the Jameh Mosque of Oshtorjan, is a Shi'ite Friday mosque (jāmeh), located in Ashtarjan, Falavarjan County, in the province of Isfahan, Iran, situated approximately 36 kilometres (22 mi) south-west of the city of Esfahan.
